Six comments

Carraigín Rua

Carraigín Rua are the first tune in this great set of reels played by the Bridge Ceili Band, I have not heard any of the tunes before, and I coudn’t find any of them here, so I ‘ripped’ Carraigín Rua by ear and I guess it’s not so far from their playing. I wil try to ‘rip’ the second reel too. Listen to them here:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=khgdDfnON4Y

↳ Posted by ceili on October 24th, 2015.

Re: Carraigín Rua

Carraigín Ruadh, X:5

Composed 1955

“Myself and my buddy Thomas Ryan were coming home from playing cards and we stopped at his gate to talk about the game, and I whistled the tune for him. He liked it and asked me what I’d call it. I said I had no name for it. There was a little hill with some trees on it across from his gate -- its name was Carragin Ruadh -- he looked over the hill and said, why no call it after that little hill across from my gate -- so I did. The next weekend he was playing it. His father and my father played together all over the parish and never got a penny for it, but they had a great time, and Tom and I were great buddies.”
--Brendan Tonra, the Music of Brendan Tonra

↳ Posted by Thady Quill on September 24th, 2024.
